dcterms:description: The NLU-Benchmark dataset is annotated with scenarios, actions, and entities, covering multiple home assistant tasks such as playing music or calendar queries. It contains 25,716 utterances split into 10 folds, with each fold having its own train and test set.
dcterms:title: NLU-Benchmark

dcterms:description: ATIS is a well-studied dataset comprising annotated transcripts of audio recordings of people making flight reservations. It includes training, development, and test sets with a total of 4,478 training utterances, 500 development utterances, and 893 test utterances.
dcterms:title: ATIS

dcterms:description: The SNIPS dataset is collected from the Snips personal voice assistant and contains 13,784 training examples and 700 test examples. It is designed for intent classification and entity recognition tasks.
dcterms:title: SNIPS
